sampling: difficulty-stratified proportional allocation by largest remainder, random.Random(seed).sample on lexicographically sorted IDs per stratum; final IDs sorted

replacement.reason: 438 unrelated pinned FAIL_TO_PASS IDs do not correspond to URLValidator hidden tests
replacement.rule: Draw a seventh value from the <15 min stratum with the same seeded RNG state before drawing the later strata; replace only the defective original ID.
